name: petcareapp
description: Pawfect Care: run the backend and frontend together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend/server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend/server run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend/server start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend/server test && npm --prefix frontend test
